capabilities: Preview .url files as a card view
Edit the URL inline and write changes back in INI format
Open shortcuts in the default app or the Web Viewer
Convert .url files to Markdown notes with the link in frontmatter
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The Web Viewer action is desktop-only and hidden unless that core plugin is enabled; the plugin makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated handling for Windows Internet Shortcut (.url) files, so vaults that contain synced or dragged-in shortcuts show them as opaque files.

relations.evidence: One action, Open in web viewer, depends on Obsidian's own optional Web viewer core plugin

summary: Registers a preview view for Windows .url shortcut files, rendering them as cards with inline URL editing, open actions, and Markdown conversion.
